title: What to Wear for Guru Nanak Gurpurab: Gurdwara & Nagar Kirtan Outfit Ideas
excerpt: What to wear for Guru Nanak Jayanti (Gurpurab): modest kurta sets with a head-covering dupatta for the gurdwara, warm layers for nagar kirtan abroad, and festive colours.
seo_title: Gurpurab Outfit Ideas: What to Wear to the Gurdwara
seo_description: Gurpurab outfit ideas for women: modest kurta sets with a dupatta to cover your head, festive colours, and warm layering for nagar kirtan in the UK, USA and Canada.
body:
## Quick answer

For **Guru Nanak Gurpurab (Guru Nanak Jayanti)**, wear a **modest kurta set or salwar suit with a dupatta** to cover your head in the gurdwara. **Saffron (kesri), yellow, white, cream and soft pastels** are popular. Choose **comfortable pants** for sitting on the floor during kirtan and langar. If you join a **nagar kirtan** procession in the UK, USA or Canada, add a **long coat and warm layers** under your outfit.

Gurpurab falls in late November in 2026 – most calendars give **24 November**, and some give 25 November. Many gurdwaras abroad hold the main celebrations on the nearest weekend, so check with your local gurdwara.

## What should women wear to the gurdwara on Gurpurab?

1. **Head covered:** a dupatta or scarf, kept on the whole time inside, including the langar hall.
2. **Modest cut:** sleeves, a higher neckline and a kurta at least knee-length.
3. **Comfortable bottoms:** straight pants or salwar, as you will sit cross-legged.
4. **Easy shoes:** you will remove them at the entrance.
5. **No tobacco or alcohol** on the premises.

A light cotton kurta set with a Kota Doria dupatta is ideal: it stays on your head without slipping and is comfortable for hours. ## Which colours are popular for Gurpurab?

| Colour | Why |
|---|---|
| Saffron / kesri and orange | Linked with the Nishan Sahib and Sikh festivals |
| Yellow and mustard | Bright and festive for a day of celebration |
| White and cream | Simple, peaceful and often worn to the gurdwara |
| Pastels – peach, powder blue, mint | Soft and elegant for daytime |

There are no strict colour rules – choose something modest and festive. For a dressier evening, the [coral pink chanderi kurta set](/products/coral-pink-chanderi-hand-embroidered-kurta-pant-dupatta-set/) ($52) adds a gentle sheen.

## What to wear for nagar kirtan abroad

In the UK, Canada and the USA, nagar kirtan processions often take place on cold November weekends:

- **Base layer:** thermal leggings under straight pants, a thin thermal top under the kurta.
- **Over the top:** a long wool coat or a padded jacket in a neutral colour.
- **Head:** a warm shawl or a dupatta over a woollen beanie-style cap if it is very cold – keep your head covered.
- **Feet:** comfortable boots for walking; you can switch to easy slip-ons inside the gurdwara.

More ideas: [what to wear to an Indian wedding in winter](/blog/what-to-wear-to-an-indian-wedding-in-winter-guest-guide/).

## Doing seva in the langar

If you help in the langar kitchen, choose cotton you can wash easily, tie your dupatta securely, and avoid long trailing sleeves or loose fabric near the stoves.

## What should a non-Sikh visitor wear?

The same: a modest outfit with covered shoulders and legs, and a scarf or dupatta to cover your hair. Visitors are always welcome at the gurdwara and the langar. For the full etiquette, see our [Sikh wedding and gurdwara dress code guide](/blog/what-to-wear-to-a-sikh-anand-karaj-as-a-guest/).

## Frequently asked questions

**What should I wear for Gurpurab?**
A modest kurta set or salwar suit with a dupatta to cover your head, in saffron, yellow, white, cream or pastels, with comfortable pants for sitting on the floor.

**When is Guru Nanak Gurpurab in 2026?**
In late November – most calendars give 24 November 2026. Gurdwaras abroad often celebrate on the nearest weekend, so check locally.

**Do I need to cover my head at the gurdwara on Gurpurab?**
Yes. Everyone covers their head inside the gurdwara, including in the langar hall.

**What should I wear for nagar kirtan in the cold?**
Thermal layers under your kurta set, a long coat, warm boots and a shawl or dupatta over your head.

**Can non-Sikhs attend Gurpurab at the gurdwara?**
Yes. Everyone is welcome. Wear modest clothes, cover your head and remove your shoes.
